note: fork-2 tier 2 (nearest display edge): the focused origin y=200 TIES the neighbor cell midpoint (y=200) within tol, so tier 1 cannot decide. Tier 2 compares the FOCUSED origin (200) to the DISPLAY midpoint (540): 200 < 540 -> nearer the TOP edge -> LEADING (north) half. (On a tier-1 tie the focused origin equals the neighbor cell midpoint by construction, so this also reads as 'the neighbor cell sits in the top half'.) The old centre-only rule had NO branch for this.
